identityReview: Matched Ola cofounder Bhavish Aggarwal through IIT Bombay, early direct interview, Ola Electric prospectus and current reporting. Distinguished cofounder Ankit Bhati and separate ride-hailing, electric-vehicle and Krutrim legal entities.
lifeStatusEvidence: November 12, 2026 Fortune India coverage quotes his Q2 shareholder letter and identifies him as Ola Electric chairman and managing director. NSE board outcome confirms the reporting date and period.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Read relevant IIT Bombay biography, 2011 YourStory interview, selected parsed prospectus passages, Reuters syndicated reports, Krutrim launch report and Fortune India article. Read only parsed cover text of November 2026 NSE results filing, not its financial tables. Separate August 2024 NSE PDF could not be opened due to tool size limit and is not treated as fully read.
sourceReview.scope: Identity, education, cofounding, incorporation, product delivery, recall, IPO, AI launch and latest attributed business assessment.
corrections: IIT Bombay confirms 2008 B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering. Two years at Microsoft Research do not imply a graduate degree. Ankit Bhati’s separate mechanical engineering qualifications are not transferred to Aggarwal.
IIT biography spells cofounder Bhatia; early direct interview supports Ankit Bhati. Founding in 2010 and operations beginning in late December are distinct milestones.
Prospectus gives August 28, 1985 birth date; profile retains only 1985. February 3, 2017 is Ola Electric incorporation, not February 2 memorandum subscription or Ola ride-hailing founding.
Ola Electric converted from private to public limited company in 2023; this is separate from August 9, 2024 market debut. Neither event lists Ola ride-hailing or Krutrim.
Prospectus dates S1 Pro first deliveries to December 2021. Earlier product announcement does not establish customer deliveries.

April 24, 2022 Reuters report confirms voluntary recall of 1,441 scooters in a specific batch following a vehicle fire. This does not mean all recalled vehicles burned. Company preliminary explanation is not a final independent finding.

December 15, 2023 Krutrim event unveiled AI models; rollout and APIs remained staged plans. It is not the incorporation date, proof of open-source licensing, completed rollout or independently verified performance.

November 12, 2026 supply-versus-demand assessment is attributed to Aggarwal’s shareholder letter. Consolidated results remained loss-making; company statements about a segment or adjusted performance do not establish group profitability.

The latest quarter ended September 30, 2026 and is Q2 FY27. NSE cover confirms unaudited standalone and consolidated reporting, but financial-table verification is not claimed. Fortune India article supports the loss description.
Current role uses Ola Electric chairman and managing director. Historical Ola CEO labels are not assumed current across all related companies. Driver, cofounder and team contributions are preserved.
